ITEM 1 | Dark purple-black cubed pieces, about 2 cm, with glossy, slightly wrinkled skin and soft, pale cut interiors, cooked to a sheen and clustered upper-left of the plate | 120
ITEM 2 | Orange, glossy, roughly cylindrical slices and chunks about 1-2 cm thick, with a smooth, slightly caramelized surface, scattered between the dark cubes and the top-right fillet | 60
ITEM 3 | Golden-tan cubes about 2 cm per side with a pan-fried, browned exterior and a matte, firm, pale interior, arranged in a loose cluster lower-left | 110
ITEM 4 | Thin, irregular, reddish-brown slices with darker browned, slightly charred edges and moist, dense-looking surfaces, lying on top of dark green leaves in the lower center | 80
ITEM 5 | Pale golden, glossy fillet about 6 x 4 cm with a crisp, light-browned top, partly covered by fine green herb strands, sitting upper-right | 130
ITEM 6 | Pale cream-to-golden flaky piece about 7 x 4 cm with a moist, layered, tender look, topped with thin green herb fronds, sitting center-right | 110
ITEM 7 | Golden-brown crusted piece about 6 x 5 cm with a bumpy, textured, slightly crunchy coating dotted with small seed-like flecks, lower-right of the plate | 100
ITEM 8 | Dark green, flat, glossy leaves, a few cm across, partly tucked under the meat slices in the lower center | 25
ITEM 9 | Pale green, thin, stringy herb fronds scattered across the fillets and along the plate edge, slightly wilted and dry-looking | 5
ITEM 10 | Pale green, soft, fibrous stalk pieces about 1 cm wide and 6 cm long, with a moist surface, lying across the center beside the fillet | 40
